title: Smooth normalization of a tame radical cover of a marked curve
statement:
Let $K$ be a field and $C$ a smooth projective geometrically integral $K$-curve, with $F=K(C)$. Let $n>0$ be invertible in $K$ and assume $K$ contains all $n$th roots of unity. Let $a_1,\ldots,a_r\in F^\times$ be finitely many nonzero rational functions. Suppose each $a_j$ and its inverse are regular on $C\setminus D$, where $D\subset C$ is a reduced finite etale closed subscheme. Let $M\subset C$ be another reduced finite etale closed subscheme disjoint from $D$. In an algebraic closure of $F$, set $L=F(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_r)$ with $\alpha_j^n=a_j$. Let $\widetilde C$ be the normalization of $C$ in $L$ and let $E=\{z\in L:z\text{ is algebraic over }K\}$. Then $L/F$ is finite Galois, $E/K$ is finite separable, and $\widetilde C\to C$ is finite surjective and etale above $C\setminus D$. The curve $\widetilde C$ is smooth over $K$, and its structural morphism factors canonically through $\operatorname{Spec}E$; over $E$ it is smooth projective and geometrically integral, with function field $L$. The reduced inverse image of $M$ is finite etale over $E$. Also $K$ is algebraically closed in $F$, and hence $E\cap F=K$ inside $L$. Empty $D,M$ and an empty list of functions are allowed.

The notions used are [def-weil-field], [def-pc-smooth-projective-curve], [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], [def-sc-function-field], [def-pc-field-extension], [def-fin-normalization-extension], [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], [def-weil-etale-morphism], [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], [def-pc-genus], [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Normal means that every local ring is an integrally closed domain. A finite separable extension is a finite-dimensional field extension whose elements have separable minimal polynomials. Group actions on schemes and fields may be nonfaithful and semilinear on the ground field.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-multiradical-galois-degree] with base field $F=K(C)$. The roots of unity already lie in $K\subset F$, and $n$ remains invertible. It gives that $L/F$ is finite Galois and $d=[L:F]$ divides $n^r$. Thus, in positive characteristic $p$, $p\nmid d$. This includes $r=0$, when $L=F$ and $d=1$.

proof.text: Put $U=C\setminus D$. Apply [lem-sfb-radical-normalization-projective-etale] with this $U$, the given $a_j,\alpha_j,n$, and the finite extension from step 1. Its unit hypothesis is exactly the regularity of $a_j$ and $a_j^{-1}$ off $D$. Thus $Y=\widetilde C$ is a normal integral projective $K$-curve, $\nu:Y\to C$ is finite surjective and etale over $U$, and its specified generic morphism identifies $K(Y)=L$.

Use $U=C\setminus D$ and the given $M$, which lies in $U$ by disjointness. Under the specified identification $K(Y)=L$, its constant subfield is exactly the stated $E$. The lemma gives finite separability of $E/K$, the canonical structural and generic factorizations, smooth projectivity and geometric integrality over $E$, the reduced finite etale inverse marking, and $K$ algebraically closed in $F$ with $E\cap F=K$. These are all remaining conclusions. Empty markings and the empty radical list satisfy the cited hypotheses.
